note: Run: python code/evaluation/benchmark_vision.py --version v4 to populate with real VLM results. Free-tier throttle: ~13s/image; est. 9 min for 20 sample rows.

no_model_baseline.description: Pipeline with no VLM — preflight-only mode. All outputs are not_enough_information.
no_model_baseline.note: issue_type and object_part are populated from ClaimExtractionAgent (text-only), which achieves reasonable accuracy. claim_status requires VLM.

expected_with_vlm.description: Expected ranges after connecting a real VLM based on prompt v4 design.
expected_with_vlm.primary_bottleneck: object_confusion (65% of no-model errors) — v4 prompt addresses this with explicit object-type question in Step 1

operational_analysis.cache_strategy: SHA-256 content-addressed JSONL cache — identical images across claims reuse the cached VLM response
operational_analysis.retry_strategy: Parse 'retry in Xs' from 429 responses; sleep accordingly; 2 retries per image
